newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand 1996 petroleum demand up 9.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Thailand 1996 petroleum demand up 9.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Thailand's petroleum demand in 1996 grew 9.8 percent year on year to 884,550 barrels per day (bpd), the Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) said on Friday.
Consumption of refined oil products rose 8.9 percent to average 720,350 bpd while demand for natural gas grew by 13.9 percent from 1995 to reach 164,200 bpd.
The demand for natural gas for local industries increased by 73.6 percent ot 24,060 bpd. The rest was used for power generation.
Petroleum purchases for the whole of 1996 averaged 1,058,210 bpd, a 20.9 percent rise from 1995. Procurement from local sources rose 15.5 percent to 282,000 bpd of petroleum.
